newsitem.title: USA: AAON sees improved sales, earnings.
newsitem.headline: AAON sees improved sales, earnings.

text.p: AAON Inc said Monday it expects improved sales and earnings throughout 1997.
Earlier, it reported first quarter earnings of $0.12 a share, up from $0.07 a year ago. Revenues rose to $16.9 million from $13.4 million.
"Our customer base is expanding and we expect the upward trend in sales and earnings to continue throughout the year," Norman Asbjornson, president, said in a statement.
AAON earned $0.34 a share on sales of $62.8 million for all of 1996.
AAON makes rootop commercial heating and air conditioning equipment, and air conditioning coils.
